What I Do

Services

End-to-end development services — from design to deployment, built for long-term maintainability.

Web Design & Development

Responsive websites built with clean HTML/CSS, PHP backends, and WordPress. Optimized for speed, SEO, and conversion.

Mobile App Development

Native Android applications with intuitive UI, smooth performance, and reliable backend integration. Built for the long term.

Desktop Applications

Maintenance & Support
